text:
incident-bot: PAGER: sustained high error rate and latency on vector-route (/v1/embeddings) — multiple alerts triggered (qps spike + 5xx)

mike_sre: Ack. Oncall assigned: @oncall taking lead. Paging call in 2 mins.

oncall: I'm on it. Quick snapshot: global qps ~3x baseline; shard s-9 showing CPU steal and KV cache churn. One tenant (ten-042) is 60% of traffic right now.

sara_eng: Any pattern on payloads? are these bulk jobs or many small requests?

oncall: Mostly small concurrent requests, ~1k req/s, many < 50 tokens each. Appears like a migration or bulk index.

mike_sre: Mitigation plan (fast): 1) apply emergency per-tenant cap on vector-route 2) carve traffic onto warm pool for high-volume tenants 3) disable non-essential rerank/secondary flows that fan-out to embeddings 4) monitor and notify customers. Agree?

jenn_prod: Hold on external comms until we split paying vs free-tier impact. We should protect SLAs for paying customers.

ops: I'm ready to apply quota. Will execute a scoped change: PATCH /admin/quotas {"route":"vector-route","scope":"tenant","tenant_id":"ten-042","qps":20} and set global per-tenant soft cap 50 for vector-route.

luis_support: Ten-042 PM just messaged support — they started a migration job. They will halt if we ask, but might need an hour. Preparing a support DM.

oncall: Applying quota now (do not run unrelated deploys):
```bash
curl -X PATCH "https://api.redwood.test/admin/quotas" -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"route":"vector-route","scope":"tenant","tenant_id":"ten-042","qps":20}'
```

ops: Applied quota change. Also toggled global per-tenant soft cap = 50 on vector-route. Early telemetry: errors down from 8% -> 1.2% and p95 latency improving.

sara_eng: Nice. Recommend keeping rerank off for the vector-route to avoid extra fan-out; we can keep chat-route untouched. Also consider enabling aggressive KV prefix caching for repeat keys.

mike_sre: Agreed. We're disabling rerank fallback for vector-route now: `feature-toggle set vector-route.rerank false --env prod`

luis_support: Ten-042 confirmed they can pause the migration for 40 mins. They've accepted temporary throttling. I'll update the ticket and CS note.

oncall: Handing off monitoring: @tom_infra you're on until 2h after this message. Please watch errors, slot usage on s-9, and be ready to revert quota if we see regressions.

tom_infra: Got it. Running a capacity carve and setting an automated watch. Command: `shard-carve --shard s-9 --reserve 200 --for-tenants ten-100,ten-212`

jenn_prod: I'll draft a short status page blurb: cause = high-volume tenant migration hitting vector-route, mitigation = tenant throttled and rerank disabled, impact = intermittent errors for high-volume tenant and elevated latency for vector-route, next steps = follow-up root cause + quota policy review.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: emergency quota applied and rerank disabled for vector-route. Metrics trending toward baseline. Monitoring for 60m.

mike_sre: After stabilization, we should add a per-tenant migration protection rule (auto-throttle for background bulk jobs) and update onboarding docs to recommend chunked runs.

sara_eng: Also add a telemetry tag for "bulk-migration" so we can surface these patterns faster.

oncall: Leaving notes in the incident doc and handoff checklist. If anything flares, call paging again. :thumbsup:

ops: Confirming last observed error rate drop to 0.9% and qps back to 1.05x baseline. Reopening ticket if we see >2x traffic persist for 15m.

jenn_prod: Thanks team — drafting post-incident follow-up and outreach for ten-042.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED (monitoring): quotas remain enforced until formal rollback.
